newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Ferrell FX index rose 0.8 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Ferrell FX index rose 0.8 pct in April.

text.p: The Ferrell FX index rose 0.8 percent in April, compared with a 0.2 percent decline in March, Ferrell Capital Management said Monday.
The median return in April was a 0.6 percent gain, and 24 of the 36 programs in the survey reported positive results.
For the second consecutive month, Quantitative Financial Strategies Inc of Conshohocken, Pa., turned in the top performance, reporting gains of 6.5 percent.

Staines Currency Investment Management of Geneva, Switzerland, posted the second best performance, up 5.8 percent, and GaiaCorp Ireland Ltd of Dublin, Ireland came in third, rising 4.8 percent, Ferrell said.
The Ferrell index was up 7.4 percent year-to-date.
